Route 222 – Pokémon & Locations

Every wild Pokémon on Route 222 in Diamond/Pearl/Platinum: catch rates, levels and trainers, plus the Diamond/Pearl differences and a calculated best-catch tip. Data as of Platinum. Route 222 connects Pastoria City with Sunyshore City.
